title: Shared review for meal-plan shopping list feature
description: Perform the final cross-cutting review of implementation, tests, and docs with attention to orchestration boundaries, regression risk, and adherence to the locked product decisions in the spec.
acceptance_criteria: Review verifies the implementation stays orchestration-focused and does not reimplement existing aggregation, rendering, or file I/O helpers.
Review checks locked UX decisions: default name, duplicate-name retry, provenance format, modal View flow, and out-of-scope exclusions.
Review confirms shared testing and documentation beads completed satisfactorily and no uncovered high-risk gaps remain.
Review output records any residual risks, follow-up items, or sign-off status for the feature.
